item.title: Top 6 Steps to Configure .NET Launch Order in JetBrains Rider
item.description:
Configuring the launch order of .NET projects in JetBrains Rider, especially for complex setups like Blazor and MAUI applications, can be tricky. Unlike Visual Studio, which provides an easy Configuration Manager, Rider might seem to enforce an alphabetical order by default. This guide outlines a detailed approach to customize the launch order using both built-in and creative methods, making sure your projects launch exactly as intended.

Top 6 Steps to Configure .NET Launch Order in JetBrains Rider

1. Create a New Launch Configuration

Begin by setting up a new launch configuration in Rider. Navigate to the “Run/Debug Configurations” dialog and add a new configuration. Choose the type based on your project needs, whether it’s for a .NET Core application, a Blazor server, or a MAUI client.
